activity_summary: After the letter you said the word likely was a small word to carry a hundred miles, and better small and true. You shut the coffer lid. You did not add a date or a sum.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Spoke the word and shut the lid.

facets.activity: Shut the coffer lid on the word likely

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Likely. A small word to carry a hundred miles. Better small and true.
